metadata.description: Design real, editable artifacts on Moda from any coding agent: decks, documents, social creative, diagrams, hosted websites, brand-true designs, and precise canvas edits over the moda CLI.

plugins.name: moda
plugins.description: Nine skills (moda-deck, moda-one-pager, moda-social, moda-diagram, moda-website, moda-video, moda-brand, moda-edit, moda-help) plus the /moda router. Requires the moda CLI; Step 0 in every skill checks it and never installs anything itself.
